name: reporter_cluster_histogram_handbook
description: Histogram reporter handbook: 8 per-asset layouts + 3 cross-sectional layouts covering bins, bin_width, analytics, reference lines, plot bands, formatting, styling, multi-asset overlay.
source:
# ========================================================================
# Histogram Handbook — All Layouts
# Assets: SPY, QQQ, DIA | Timeframe: 1D
# ========================================================================

# === Market Data ===
src = study_assets()
close = src.c
high = src.h
low = src.l
volume = src.v

# === Core Derived Series ===
daily_ret = (close - (close >> 1)) / (close >> 1)
intraday_range = (high - low) / close
log_ret = ln(close / (close >> 1))

# --- L1: Basic histogram with defaults ---
histogram(
    title='L1: Daily Return Distribution',
    category='01 L1: Basic',
    bins=50,
    x_axis_label='Daily Return',
    y_axis_label='Frequency'
)(daily_ret)

# --- L2: Custom bin count with fill color ---
histogram(
    title='L2: Return Distribution (20 Bins, Blue)',
    category='02 L2: Custom Bins',
    bins=20,
    fill_color=Color.Blue,
    x_axis_label='Daily Return'
)(daily_ret)

# --- L3: Fixed bin width ---
histogram(
    title='L3: Return Distribution (Fixed 0.5% Width)',
    category='03 L3: Bin Width',
    bin_width=0.005,
    x_axis_format=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
    x_axis_dp=1,
    x_axis_label='Daily Return'
)(daily_ret)

# --- L4: Show analytics (mode, ±1σ) ---
histogram(
    title='L4: Return Distribution with Analytics',
    category='04 L4: Analytics',
    bins=40,
    show_analytics=True,
    fill_color=Color.Blue,
    fill_opacity=0.6,
    x_axis_format=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
    x_axis_dp=2,
    x_axis_label='Daily Return'
)(daily_ret)

# --- L5: Reference lines (zero + mean marker) ---
histogram(
    title='L5: Return Distribution with Reference Lines',
    category='05 L5: Reference Lines',
    bins=40,
    x_axis_format=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
    x_axis_dp=2,
    x_axis_label='Daily Return',
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, title='Zero', color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash, vertical=True)
    ])
)(daily_ret)

# --- L6: Percent format with integer y-axis ---
histogram(
    title='L6: Intraday Range Distribution',
    category='06 L6: Percent Format',
    bins=30,
    x_axis_format=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
    x_axis_dp=1,
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat,
    y_axis_dp=0,
    fill_color=Color.Indigo,
    x_axis_label='Intraday Range (H-L)/C'
)(intraday_range)

# --- L7: Custom fill styling ---
histogram(
    title='L7: Log Return Distribution (Styled)',
    category='07 L7: Fill Styling',
    bins=60,
    fill_color=Color.Blue,
    fill_opacity=0.5,
    x_axis_label='Log Return',
    show_analytics=True
)(log_ret)

# --- L8: Plot bands (shaded frequency regions) ---
histogram(
    title='L8: Return Distribution with Plot Bands',
    category='08 L8: Plot Bands',
    bins=30,
    x_axis_format=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
    x_axis_dp=2,
    x_axis_label='Daily Return',
    y_axis_label='Frequency',
    y_plot_bands=PlotBandSchema(bands=[
        PlotBand(from=0.0, to=5.0, color=Color.Green, opacity=0.1, label='Low Freq'),
        PlotBand(from=20.0, to=50.0, color=Color.Red, opacity=0.1, label='High Freq')
    ])
)(daily_ret)

# ========================================================================
# Cross-Sectional Layouts
# ========================================================================

# --- cs_L1: Multi-asset overlay (all assets) ---
cs_histogram(
    title='CS L1: Daily Return Distributions',
    category='09 cs L1: Multi-Asset',
    bins=30,
    fill_opacity=0.4,
    x_axis_label='Daily Return',
    y_axis_label='Frequency'
)(daily_ret)

# --- cs_L2: Max assets limit ---
cs_histogram(
    title='CS L2: Top 2 Return Distributions',
    category='10 cs L2: Max Assets',
    bins=30,
    max_assets=2,
    fill_opacity=0.4,
    x_axis_label='Daily Return',
    y_axis_label='Frequency'
)(daily_ret)

# --- cs_L3: Percent format overlay ---
cs_histogram(
    title='CS L3: Return Distributions (%)',
    category='11 cs L3: Percent Format',
    bins=30,
    x_axis_format=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
    x_axis_dp=2,
    fill_opacity=0.4,
    x_axis_label='Daily Return (%)',
    y_axis_label='Frequency'
)(daily_ret)
